{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.00) to account for bearish market pressure.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% downward correction in the next 3-5 days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above true outcome for 3+ consecutive days, reduce by 5-10% per day until convergence.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent true outcomes when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to capture bullish momentum.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, reduce volatility by smoothing out extreme outliers in the forecast curve, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "When sentiment shows increasing positivity (e.g., 0.00 → 0.50 → 0.67), gradually increase forecast upward by 2-5% per sentiment step to reflect rising confidence.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., 5-10% below), apply a downward bias of 3-5% to future forecasts to avoid overconfidence."
  ]
}
